name: Acceptance suite-2 test 34 (boundary) - only 2 of the 3 takeover primitives -> NO critical takeover
note: IAM-902 boundary: the chain requires ALL THREE of a permission-grant primitive, iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, AND sts:AssumeRole on the same role. This policy grants only the modify legs (iam:PutRolePolicy + iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy) and NO sts:AssumeRole, so the compound ROLE-TAKEOVER must NOT fire; the two standalone primitives still surface individually.
